notes.title: Game Release as of July 13th!
notes.notes:
Thank you for checking out the game! Did you know you can get the Episode 0 demo on Steam? It's available now on the store page. For those that don't know, it's the third save file in the demo that is The Customer is Always Right! ... Otherwise, you can always play the preceding store of The Customer is Always Right!, known as the "Memory of Thoth," a mysterious game on the laptop in your room. 
 
Adventures await, my friend!
